findings.description: Selected 4e256aeb-9d90-4e11-9e58-4299c38c424b native names/comment support petroleum refinery asphalt, but canonical source classification leaf 15330 explicitly denotes natural bitumen/asphalt/asphaltites/asphaltic rock. The PCR excludes natural asphaltic rock and qualifies petroleum coating asphalt but does not disclose that source contradiction or track source-owner classification clarification. This is incomplete disclosure of an identity-metadata debt, not proof that the qualified physical petroleum asphalt identity is unusable.

findings.title: Packaging equality omits separate additions and removals to retained articles
findings.description: The packaging-specific equality is opening+P+I+ER=closing+S+EO+W. P/I/ER are qualified whole-article receipts; the surrounding complete clauses expressly keep independently measured repair material/water changes separate and retain them in full wet closing stock. With opening pallet mass 30 kg, no whole-article receipts, dispatch/returns/waste, and 10 kg new repair material or water retained in the pallet, closing is 40 kg. The specific equality gives 30=40 despite the conserving general physical gate giving 30+10=40. Exact reconciliation against other flow terms cannot remove the required inlet from this subledger.
findings.minimum_correction: Include independently measured, non-overlapping material/water additions on the left and removals on the right, after reconciliation with P/I/ER and S/EO/W; alternatively state an explicit equivalent restricted unchanged-article subledger and companion change balance. Preserve full wet stocks, whole-article origins and gross six legs. Apply both languages and projection.
evidence: Complete EN/ZH packaging-receipt basis defines P/I/ER as whole-article receipts and X changes as distinct; cited exact rule lines.
Arithmetic limiting case is a conservation test, not empirical plant data.
